findings.evidence: Page header contains only `<nav id="nav">` with two links. Footer contains only Privacy policy and Terms of service links. No search form, sitemap, breadcrumb, or related-links list appears anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Add at least one additional navigation mechanism: implement a site search form, add a breadcrumb navigation trail showing the page's position in the hierarchy, link to a sitemap, or include a related-pages list linking to similar content.
findings.location: #nav, the only navigation mechanism on the page
findings.violation: Readers relying on the primary navigation menu as the sole mechanism to find this page lack alternative pathways such as a site search, breadcrumb trail, or sitemap.
